title: Minimal agent event (v1)
description: DIMVA-X01 minimized authorized telemetry contract for GovernanceTrace: Detecting Adaptive Authorization-Boundary Probing from Minimal Agent Events (venue dimva, phase P02, RQ1). MINIMALITY NOTE: this schema intentionally retains exactly seven fields (actor, tool, scope, allowed, purpose, ts, campaign_id) - the smallest metadata surface that still supports authorization-boundary-probing detection at bounded benign false alarms. It excludes health text, raw user prompts, free-text reasons, PHI (patient identifiers, diagnoses, notes, contact data), clear-text principal IDs, rejection reason codes (leak-safe primary test) and any explicit attacker label; additionalProperties=false turns every extra field into a hard fail-closed validation error. Hashed scope/actor and bucketed timestamps bound the retained sensitive metadata (bytes) by construction.

actor.description: Opaque principal: SHA-256 hex digest of the synthetic actor identifier. Clear-text principal IDs are rejected (fail closed); no role, name or account field is retained.

tool.description: Coarse action class of the invoked tool (snake_case token, e.g. record_read); no argument payload, operation name or hashed-op free text beyond the class token.

scope.description: Hashed authorization scope: SHA-256 hex over the (tenant, principal, purpose, policy/consent epoch) scope tuple. Raw tenant or principal identifiers are never retained.

allowed.description: Authorization outcome of the event: true when the gateway admitted the operation, false when denied. No rejection reason code or reason family is retained (leak-safe RQ1 primary test).

purpose.description: Registered coarse purpose class under which the operation was attempted; free-text reasons are rejected by the closed enum.

ts.description: Timestamp bucket: epoch seconds divided into fixed 60 s buckets (epoch_seconds // 60). Coarse timing supports pacing features without high-resolution metadata; no wall-clock string is retained.

campaign_id.description: Opaque session/campaign grouping identifier assigned by the synthetic trace generator; carries no personal or health semantics.
